meta.workDescription: Prepares Duty Position Evaluation questions, scenarios, and Task Performance Checklists (TPC's) for use in training and evaluation of over 540 Security Forces personnel. Prepares and administers examinations for 17 different critical and duty positions. Schedules unit personnel for initial and annual standardization evaluation appointments. Conducts realistic practical performance evaluations of individuals and teams. Aids in conducting annual inspections of unit work centers, ensuring compliance with policies and procedures. Prepares exercise scenarios as a trusted agent for the 48 FW Inspection Team during Wing inspections. Monitors and tracks QC trends and Squadron MICT Checklists.
meta.riskManagementNotes:
RM is a continuous, sequential methodology consisting of a defined process depending onmission requirements.

Accept No Unnecessary Risk: If not all the hazards are identified, then too much risk may
be accepted.

Make Decisions At The Appropriate Level: Those accountable for the success or failure of
the mission must be included in the risk-decision process. This establishes clear
accountability. Commanders must ensure subordinates know how much risk they may
accept and when they must elevate the decision to a higher level.

Training is required and available on ADLS.
meta.trafficSafetyNotes: Licensing: All personnel who operate a private motor vehicle or a government motor vehicle will maintain current a 3AF Form 435, 3AF Driving/Fuel Permit United Kingdom.
meta.motorcycleSafetyReps:
